references.text: Concerns foreigners living among the Israelites and their rights, including the possibility of buying their freedom.
Previous verses describing that slaves can be purchased from the nations around Israel.
The continuation explaining that these slaves can be inherited by descendants.
Mentions immigrants and hired workers as a distinct category among people living in Israel.
Refers to foreigners and immigrants living among the Israelites.
Prophesies about foreigners living in the land who receive an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
Abraham's covenant includes circumcision for slaves bought with money and those born in his household.
Describes Solomon's census of foreigners in the land who were assigned to forced labor.
